verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a full REST API for creating workflows, managing event sources, and subscriptions, plus dedicated Connect API/SDKs (TypeScript, Python, Java) with clear auth patterns (external_user_id) and usage APIs, alongside a CLI and MCP server for programmatic/agentic access. This gives AI-native users multiple well-documented, official surfaces to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of the REST API's completeness/reliability beyond vendor docs.
